metadata.question: Does the surface water extent increase in the area between the Elkhorn and Platte Rivers near Omaha in March 16, 2019 compared to March 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: JRC Global Surface Water or Sentinel-1 SAR for water detection, or use water indices from optical data (Sentinel-2/Landsat) - Date: March 2018 vs March 16, 2019 - Location: Area between Elkhorn and Platte Rivers near Omaha, Nebraska (approximately -96.0°W, 41.25°N) 2. Masking strategy: - This is about water extent comparison, so I need to identify water pixels - For optical: Use water indices like NDWI or MNDWI - For SAR: Use Sentinel-1 VV/VH polarization - JRC Surface Water might be too coarse for specific date comparison - I'll use Sentinel-2 with MNDWI (Modified Normalized Difference Water Index) 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: Water area could legitimately be 0 or very small in dry periods → Answer B (no increase) if 2019 ≤ 2018 - C1: No images found for either period - C2: Images exist but all masked out (clouds/invalid) - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN - A: 2019 water extent > 2018 water extent - B: 2019 water extent ≤ 2018 water extent ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define geometry - area between Elkhorn and Platte Rivers near Omaha const omaha = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-96.2, 41.15], [-96.2, 41.35], [-95.8, 41.35], [-95.8, 41.15], [-96.2, 41.15]] ]); // 2. Helper function to calculate water extent function calculateWaterExtent(startDate, endDate, label) { const collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(omaha) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)); const size = collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`${label} Images found: ${size}`); if (size === 0) { // Try Landsat 8 as fallback const landsatCol = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(omaha) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); const lSize = landsatCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`${label} Landsat fallback: ${lSize} images`); if (lSize === 0) { return { valid: false, reason: 'C1' }; } // Use Landsat const image = landsatCol.median(); const green = image.select('SR_B3').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2); const swir = image.select('SR_B6').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2); const mndwi = green.subtract(swir).divide(green.add(swir)); const water = mndwi.gt(0); const stats = water.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', true), geometry: omaha, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const waterPixels = stats.get('sum').getInfo(); const totalPixels = stats.get('count').getInfo(); console.log(`${label} Water pixels: ${waterPixels}, Total: ${totalPixels}`); if (totalPixels === 0) { return { valid: false, reason: 'C2' }; } return { valid: true, waterPixels: waterPixels || 0 }; } // Use Sentinel-2 const image = collection.median(); const green = image.select('B3').multiply(0.0001); const swir = image.select('B11').multiply(0.0001); const mndwi = green.subtract(swir).divide(green.add(swir)); const water = mndwi.gt(0); const stats = water.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', true), geometry: omaha, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const waterPixels = stats.get('sum').getInfo(); const totalPixels = stats.get('count').getInfo(); console.log(`${label} Water pixels: ${waterPixels}, Total: ${totalPixels}`); if (totalPixels === 0) { return { valid: false, reason: 'C2' }; } return { valid: true, waterPixels: waterPixels || 0 }; } // 3. Calculate water extent for both periods const march2018 = calculateWaterExtent('2018-03-01', '2018-03-31', 'March 2018'); if (!march2018.valid) { console.log(`${march2018.reason}`); return; } const march2019 = calculateWaterExtent('2019-03-10', '2019-03-22', 'March 16 2019'); if (!march2019.valid) { console.log(`${march2019.reason}`); return; } // 4. Compare water extents const pixels2018 = march2018.waterPixels; const pixels2019 = march2019.waterPixels; if (pixels2018 === null || pixels2019 === null || isNaN(pixels2018) || isNaN(pixels2019)) { console.log('C3'); return; } console.log(`2018 water: ${pixels2018} pixels`); console.log(`2019 water: ${pixels2019} pixels`); console.log(`Difference: ${pixels2019 - pixels2018} pixels`); if (pixels2019 > pixels2018) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
